title: UGREEN Nexode 65W USB-C Charger — 3-Port GaN, PD 3.0, Compact
short_description: A compact 65W USB-C charger with GaN technology and 3 ports (2x USB-C + 1x USB-A). Charges laptop, tablet and phone at the same time, fast.
long_description: The UGREEN Nexode 65W is a compact GaN charger with three ports (2x USB-C + 1x USB-A). It delivers up to 65W on a C port and supports fast charging protocols like PD 3.0, QC 4+/3.0 and PPS. It charges MacBook, iPhone, iPad and other laptops quickly — even several devices at once. Thanks to GaN technology it stays small (66 x 40 x 31 mm), ideal for travel and the desk.
buying_angle: Practical for anyone who wants to fast-charge a laptop, tablet and phone with a single compact power supply at the desk or on the go.
